execution: Node VM executing the unchanged built inline game. Eventful minimal DOM, memory/denied Storage, Canvas/WebGL, lifecycle and Blob-download test doubles. This is not a browser, layout, pixel, OS file-picker, actual download or file:// durability test.

results.name: Existing v28 browser key and standalone resource contract stay intact
Boot inspects valid saves without writing or advancing a default character
Launcher blocks pause shortcut, movement and automatic saving until an explicit choice
Registered Continue button restores the real saved character without rewriting it
Explicit new exploration uses the chosen class and protects the old slot until save
Manual save backs up the previous valid primary before committing the candidate
A refused backup write leaves both existing slots untouched
A refused primary commit retains the original primary and a valid previous copy
Protected corrupt primary survives startup, new play and denied automatic save
Explicit damaged-save preservation writes the original before replacing the primary
Failed damaged-original preservation cannot overwrite the protected primary
Explicit previous-save recovery preserves damaged original and restores the playable character
Storage getter rejection still permits memory-only play and visible JSON guidance
Storage getItem rejection still permits memory-only play and visible JSON guidance
Storage setItem rejection still permits memory-only play and visible JSON guidance
Registered physical-key movement works and modal editing cannot move the hero
Blur clears held movement and click destination before pausing
visibilitychange pauses, clears input and persists recent progress through the real listener
pagehide pauses, clears input and persists recent progress through the real listener
Async local-file import pauses while reading and does not replace stored slots before explicit save
Invalid or unreadable file imports preserve all gameplay data and existing saved bytes
Oversize local files are refused before reading their contents
An older asynchronous file read cannot replace a later explicit new exploration
Registered JSON paste-import button uses the same validated migration path
JSON export requests a local Blob download and always leaves selectable backup text
Denied download API leaves a usable JSON-text fallback and no uncaught exception
Original damaged storage can be exported byte-for-byte without altering any slot
Unavailable WebGL retains the playable 2D route instead of selecting an invalid mode
Context-loss event chooses 2D, clears input and leaves valid game data
An actual frame callback error becomes a stopped, readable fatal state
All tested boot, save, input and backup paths attempted zero network requests

detail.networkAPIs: fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket, EventSource, Worker, sendBeacon, serviceWorker.register denied before boot
